```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

read_exam_data <- function(
  x = c(
    "data_tidy_stress.csv", "data_tidy_lum_meta.csv",
    "data_tidy_lum_response.csv", "pca_image_results.rds"
  )) {
  x <- match.arg(x)
  path_data_vec <- c(file.path("data", x), x)
  if (requireNamespace("projr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    path_data_vec <- c(
      path_data_vec,
      tryCatch(
        projr::projr_path_get("raw-data", "data", x),
        error = function(e) character(0L)
      )
    )
  }
  if (!any(file.exists(path_data_vec))) {
    stop("no paths found")
  }
  path_data <- path_data_vec[file.exists(path_data_vec)]
  path_data <- path_data[!is.na(path_data)]
  path_data <- path_data[nzchar(path_data)]
  if (length(path_data) == 0L) {
    stop("path_data has zero length")
  }
  path_data <- path_data[[1]]
  if (grepl("\\.csv$", path_data)) {
    if (!requireNamespace("readr", quietly = TRUE)) {
      utils::install.packages("readr")
    }
    tryCatch({
      readr::read_csv(path_data)
    }, error = function(e) read.csv(path_data, header = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    readRDS(path_data)
  }
}

save_img <- function(x, file) {
  # x: matrix of pixel values (0-1)
  # file: path to save the image (e.g., "reconstructed_image.jpg").
  #       Must specify file extension as .jpg, .png or .pdf.
  if (grepl("\\.jpg$", file)) {
    save_func <- jpeg::writeJPEG
  } else if (grepl("\\.png$", file)) {
    save_func <- png::writePNG
  } else if (grepl("\\.pdf$", file)) {
      save_func <- function(x, file) {
        pdf(file, width = ncol(x)/100, height = nrow(x)/100)
        par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
        plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(0, ncol(x)), ylim = c(0, nrow(x)), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
        rasterImage(x, 0, 0, ncol(x), nrow(x))
        dev.off()
      }
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file format. Use .jpg or .png")
  }
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(x))) {
    x[, j] <- pmax(pmin(1, x[, j]), 0)
  }
  save_func(
    x,
    file
  )
  file
}
```

### Question 3.3

In `data_tidy_lum_response`, the variables `crp` to `il1ra` are one set of variables ($\mathbf{X}^{(1)}$), and the variables `mcp1` to `scd40l` are another set ($\mathbf{X}^{(2)}$).

Standardise the variables in `data_tidy_lum_response`, creating a new matrix `lum_response_mat_std`, using this code, and use `lum_response_mat_std` for question 3.3:

```{r}
if (!exists("data_tidy_lum")) {
  stop("Please run code above to create the `data_tidy_lum` object.")
}
lum_response_mat_std <- data_tidy_lum |>
  dplyr::select(crp:scd40l) |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(dplyr::everything(), ~ (.-mean(.))/sd(.))) |>
  as.matrix()
```
